Who requires the Bermudian holiday visa for take a trip 
from USA? 
Bermudian holiday visa is given for a controlled period of 
leisure travel and no business activities permitted. A 
holiday visa stamp or label placed by a Bermudian visa 
official on your passport that lets you go to Bermuda. 
Travel visa for Bermuda are usually granted by the 
Bermudian consulate in Washington D.C. or in the 
nearest city to your normal residential address. When 
obtaining a Bermudian visitor visa, you can be expected 
to reveal the purposes for traveling to Bermuda. 
If you are a national of USA, UK or Canada, you do not 
require any kind of visa to enter Bermuda irrespective of 
whether you are a tourist, business visitor or a work 
permit holder going on a job. You are all set to go once 
you have a valid passport and return tickets (note that 
EFTA_R1_00591701 
EFTA02052104
--- PAGE 3 ---
U.S. passport cards are not acceptable in air travel). 
However nationals of countries other than USA, UK and 
Canada will require a multiple entry transit visa for USA, 
UK or Canada (as applicable depending on one's route). 
This is because such nationals will need to transit and 
return through US, UK or Canada. This visa is known as 
Multi Re-Entry Visa (MRV) which ensures that a visitor 
is able to leave Bermuda, and return to his/her own 
country via US, UK or Canada (as the case may be). 
So nationals who require and have valid MRV (Multi Re-
Entry Visa for US, UK or Canada) can now visit Bermuda 
without requiring any separate visa for Bermuda or visa 
waiver. So tourists, persons on business and work 
permit holders from such countries (including who were 
earlier Visa Controlled Nationals) now do not need a 
separate entry visa for Bermuda. However the following 
conditions must be met by them: 
1) One must show the MRV on arrival in Bermuda which 
must be valid for minimum 45 days beyond the date of 
departure or expiry of work permit (as applicable); 
2) PP# 
be valid for minimum 45 days from 
the date of departure from Bermuda or expiry of work 
permit (as the case may be). Note that this requirement 
of minimum 45 days PP# 
applies only for 
nationals requiring and holding MRV. For others (i.e. 
nationals of US, UK and Canada) one only needs to have 
a passport valid till the return journey is completed; 
3) The traveler must have valid return or onward tickets. 
http://hamilton.usconsulate.gov/how to apply2.html

Who requires the Bermudian holiday visa for take a trip 
from USA? 
Bermudian holiday visa is given for a controlled period of 
leisure travel and no business activities permitted. A 
holiday visa stamp or label placed by a Bermudian visa 
official on your passport that lets you go to Bermuda. 
Travel visa for Bermuda are usually granted by the 
Bermudian consulate in Washington D.C. or in the 
nearest city to your normal residential address. When 
obtaining a Bermudian visitor visa, you can be expected 
to reveal the purposes for traveling to Bermuda. 
If you are a national of USA, UK or Canada, you do not 
EFTA_R1_00591874 
EFTA02052226
--- PAGE 3 ---
require any kind of visa to enter Bermuda irrespective of 
whether you are a tourist, business visitor or a work 
permit holder going on a job. You are all set to go once 
you have a valid passport and return tickets (note that 
U.S. passport cards are not acceptable in air travel). 
However nationals of countries other than USA, UK and 
Canada will require a multiple entry transit visa for USA, 
UK or Canada (as applicable depending on one's route). 
This is because such nationals will need to transit and 
return through US, UK or Canada. This visa is known as 
Multi Re-Entry Visa (MRV) which ensures that a visitor is 
able to leave Bermuda, and return to his/her own 
country via US, UK or Canada (as the case may be). 
So nationals who require and have valid MRV (Multi Re-
Entry Visa for US, UK or Canada) can now visit Bermuda 
without requiring any separate visa for Bermuda or visa 
waiver. So tourists, persons on business and work permit 
holders from such countries (including who were earlier 
Visa Controlled Nationals) now do not need a separate 
entry visa for Bermuda. However the following conditions 
must be met by them: 
1) One must show the MRV on arrival in Bermuda which 
must be valid for minimum 45 days beyond the date of 
departure or expiry of work permit (as applicable); 
2) PP# 
be valid for minimum 45 days from 
the date of departure from Bermuda or expiry of work 
permit (as the case may be). Note that this requirement of 
minimum 45 days PP# 
applies only for 
nationals requiring and holding MRV. For others (i.e. 
nationals of US, UK and Canada) one only needs to have 
a passport valid till the return journey is completed; 
EFTA_R1_00591875

EFTA_R1_00591980 
EFTA02052306
--- PAGE 4 ---
Bermudian holiday visa is given for a controlled period of 
leisure travel and no business activities permitted. A 
holiday visa stamp or label placed by a Bermudian visa 
official on your passport that lets you go to Bermuda. 
Travel visa for Bermuda are usually granted by the 
Bermudian consulate in Washington D.C. or in the 
nearest city to your normal residential address. When 
obtaining a Bermudian visitor visa, you can be expected 
to reveal the purposes for traveling to Bermuda. 
If you are a national of USA, UK or Canada, you do not 
require any kind of visa to enter Bermuda irrespective of 
whether you are a tourist, business visitor or a work 
permit holder going on a job. You are all set to go once 
you have a valid passport and return tickets (note that 
U.S. passport cards are not acceptable in air travel). 
However nationals of countries other than USA, UK and 
Canada will require a multiple entry transit visa for USA, 
UK or Canada (as applicable depending on one's route). 
This is because such nationals will need to transit and 
return through US, UK or Canada. This visa is known as 
Multi Re-Entry Visa (MRV) which ensures that a visitor is 
able to leave Bermuda, and return to his/her own 
country via US, UK or Canada (as the case may be). 
So nationals who require and have valid MRV (Multi Re-
Entry Visa for US, UK or Canada) can now visit Bermuda 
without requiring any separate visa for Bermuda or visa 
waiver. So tourists, persons on business and work permit 
holders from such countries (including who were earlier 
Visa Controlled Nationals) now do not need a separate 
entry visa for Bermuda. However the following conditions 
must be met by them: 
1) One must show the MRV on arrival in Bermuda which 
must be valid for minimum 45 days beyond the date of 
EFTA_R1_00591981 
EFTA02052307
--- PAGE 5 ---
departure or expiry of work permit (as applicable); 
2) PP# 
be valid for minimum 45 days from 
the date of departure from Bermuda or expiry of work 
permit (as the case may be). Note that this requirement of 
minimum 45 days PP# 
applies only for 
nationals requiring and holding MRV. For others (i.e. 
nationals of US, UK and Canada) one only needs to have 
a passport valid till the return journey is completed; 
3) The traveler must have valid return or onward tickets. 
http://hamilton.usconsulate.gov/how to apply2.html

days passport validity applies only for nationals requiring 
and holding MRV. For others (i.e. nationals of US, UK and 
Canada) one only needs to have a passport valid till the 
return journey is completed; 
3) The traveler must have valid return or onward tickets.

Who requires the Bermudian holiday visa for take a trip 
from USA? 
Bermudian holiday visa is given for a controlled period of 
leisure travel and no business activities permitted. A 
holiday visa stamp or label placed by a Bermudian visa 
official on your passport that lets you go to Bermuda. 
Travel visa for Bermuda are usually granted by the 
Bermudian consulate in Washington D.C. or in the 
nearest city to your normal residential address. When 
obtaining a Bermudian visitor visa, you can be expected 
to reveal the purposes for traveling to Bermuda. 
If you are a national of USA, UK or Canada, you do not 
require any kind of visa to enter Bermuda irrespective of 
whether you are a tourist, business visitor or a work 
permit holder going on a job. You are all set to go once 
you have a valid passport and return tickets (note that 
U.S. passport cards are not acceptable in air travel). 
However nationals of countries other than USA, UK and 
Canada will require a multiple entry transit visa for USA, 
UK or Canada (as applicable depending on one's route). 
This is because such nationals will need to transit and 
return through US, UK or Canada. This visa is known as 
Multi Re-Entry Visa (MRV) which ensures that a visitor is 
able to leave Bermuda, and return to his/her own 
country via US, UK or Canada (as the case may be). 
So nationals who require and have valid MRV (Multi Re-
Entry Visa for US, UK or Canada) can now visit Bermuda 
without requiring any separate visa for Bermuda or visa 
waiver. So tourists, persons on business and work permit 
holders from such countries (including who were earlier 
Visa Controlled Nationals) now do not need a separate 
EFTA_R1_00592452 
EFTA02052599
--- PAGE 5 ---
entry visa for Bermuda. However the following conditions 
must be met by them: 
1) One must show the MRV on arrival in Bermuda which 
must be valid for minimum 45 days beyond the date of 
departure or expiry of work permit (as applicable); 
2) PP# 
be valid for minimum 45 days from 
the date of departure from Bermuda or expiry of work 
permit (as the case may be). Note that this requirement of 
minimum 45 days PP# 
applies only for 
nationals requiring and holding MRV. For others (i.e. 
nationals of US, UK and Canada) one only needs to have 
a passport valid till the return journey is completed; 
3) The traveler must have valid return or onward tickets. 
http://hamilton.usconsulate.gov/how to apply2.html

Bermudian holiday visa is given for a controlled period 
of leisure travel and no business activities permitted. 
A holiday visa stamp or label placed by a Bermudian 
visa official on your passport that lets you go to 
Bermuda. 
Travel visa for Bermuda are usually granted by the 
Bermudian consulate in Washington D.C. or in the 
nearest city to your normal residential address. When 
obtaining a Bermudian visitor visa, you can be 
expected to reveal the purposes for traveling to 
Bermuda. 
If you are a national of USA, UK or Canada, you do 
EFTA_R1_00592467

not require any kind of visa to enter Bermuda 
irrespective of whether you are a tourist, business 
visitor or a work permit holder going on a job. You are 
all set to go once you have a valid passport and return 
tickets (note that U.S. passport cards are not 
acceptable in air travel). 
However nationals of countries other than USA, UK 
and Canada will require a multiple entry transit visa 
for USA, UK or Canada (as applicable depending on 
one's route). This is because such nationals will need 
to transit and return through US, UK or Canada. This 
visa is known as Multi Re-Entry Visa (MRV) which 
ensures that a visitor is able to leave Bermuda, and 
return to his/her own country via US, UK or Canada 
(as the case may be). 
So nationals who require and have valid MRV (Multi 
Re-Entry Visa for US, UK or Canada) can now visit 
Bermuda without requiring any separate visa for 
Bermuda or visa waiver. So tourists, persons on 
business and work permit holders from such 
countries (including who were earlier Visa Controlled 
Nationals) now do not need a separate entry visa for 
Bermuda. However the following conditions must be 
met by them: 
1) One must show the MRV on arrival in Bermuda 
which must be valid for minimum 45 days beyond the 
date of departure or expiry of work permit (as 
applicable); 
2) PP#

from the date of departure from Bermuda or expiry of

Who requires the Bermudian holiday visa for take a trip 
from USA? 
Bermudian holiday visa is given for a controlled period of 
leisure travel and no business activities permitted. A 
holiday visa stamp or label placed by a Bermudian visa 
official on your passport that lets you go to Bermuda. 
Travel visa for Bermuda are usually granted by the 
Bermudian consulate in Washington D.C. or in the 
nearest city to your normal residential address. When 
obtaining a Bermudian visitor visa, you can be expected 
to reveal the purposes for traveling to Bermuda. 
If you are a national of USA, UK or Canada, you do not 
require any kind of visa to enter Bermuda irrespective of 
whether you are a tourist, business visitor or a work 
permit holder going on a job. You are all set to go once 
you have a valid passport and return tickets (note that 
U.S. passport cards are not acceptable in air travel). 
However nationals of countries other than USA, UK and 
EFTA_R1_00592669 
EFTA02052739
--- PAGE 5 ---
Canada will require a multiple entry transit visa for USA, 
UK or Canada (as applicable depending on one's route). 
This is because such nationals will need to transit and 
return through US, UK or Canada. This visa is known as 
Multi Re-Entry Visa (MRV) which ensures that a visitor is 
able to leave Bermuda, and return to his/her own 
country via US, UK or Canada (as the case may be). 
So nationals who require and have valid MRV (Multi Re-
Entry Visa for US, UK or Canada) can now visit Bermuda 
without requiring any separate visa for Bermuda or visa 
waiver. So tourists, persons on business and work permit 
holders from such countries (including who were earlier 
Visa Controlled Nationals) now do not need a separate 
entry visa for Bermuda. However the following conditions 
must be met by them: 
1) One must show the MRV on arrival in Bermuda which 
must be valid for minimum 45 days beyond the date of 
departure or expiry of work permit (as applicable); 
2) PP# 
be valid for minimum 45 days from 
the date of departure from Bermuda or expiry of work 
permit (as the case may be). Note that this requirement of 
minimum 45 days PP# 
applies only for 
nationals requiring and holding MRV. For others (i.e. 
nationals of US, UK and Canada) one only needs to have 
a passport valid till the return journey is completed; 
3) The traveler must have valid return or onward tickets. 
http://hamilton.usconsulate.gov/how to apply2.html

For some countries it does make difference, Canada, for example. Regular 
Russian citizens they need visa, Russian citizens with Green card, no visa.

Who requires the Bermudian holiday visa for take a trip 
from USA? 
Bermudian holiday visa is given for a controlled period of 
leisure travel and no business activities permitted. A 
holiday visa stamp or label placed by a Bermudian visa 
official on your passport that lets you go to Bermuda. 
Travel visa for Bermuda are usually granted by the 
Bermudian consulate in Washington D.C. or in the 
nearest city to your normal residential address. When 
obtaining a Bermudian visitor visa, you can be expected 
to reveal the purposes for traveling to Bermuda. 
If you are a national of USA, UK or Canada, you do not 
require any kind of visa to enter Bermuda irrespective of 
whether you are a tourist, business visitor or a work 
permit holder going on a job. You are all set to go once 
you have a valid passport and return tickets (note that 
U.S. passport cards are not acceptable in air travel). 
However nationals of countries other than USA, UK and 
Canada will require a multiple entry transit visa for USA, 
UK or Canada (as applicable depending on one's route). 
EFTA_R1_00592677 
EFTA02052747
--- PAGE 13 ---
This is because such nationals will need to transit and 
return through US, UK or Canada. This visa is known as 
Multi Re-Entry Visa (MRV) which ensures that a visitor is 
able to leave Bermuda, and return to his/her own 
country via US, UK or Canada (as the case may be). 
So nationals who require and have valid MRV (Multi Re-
Entry Visa for US, UK or Canada) can now visit Bermuda 
without requiring any separate visa for Bermuda or visa 
waiver. So tourists, persons on business and work permit 
holders from such countries (including who were earlier 
Visa Controlled Nationals) now do not need a separate 
entry visa for Bermuda. However the following conditions 
must be met by them: 
1) One must show the MRV on arrival in Bermuda which 
must be valid for minimum 45 days beyond the date of 
departure or expiry of work permit (as applicable); 
2) PP# 
be valid for minimum 45 days from 
the date of departure from Bermuda or expiry of work 
permit (as the case may be). Note that this requirement of 
minimum 45 days PP# 
applies only for 
nationals requiring and holding MRV. For others (i.e. 
nationals of US, UK and Canada) one only needs to have 
a passport valid till the return journey is completed; 
3) The traveler must have valid return or onward tickets. 
http://hamilton.usconsulate.gov/ how to apply2.html

Who requires the Bermudian holiday visa for take a trip 
from USA? 
Bermudian holiday visa is given for a controlled period of 
leisure travel and no business activities permitted. A 
holiday visa stamp or label placed by a Bermudian visa 
official on your passport that lets you go to Bermuda. 
Travel visa for Bermuda are usually granted by the 
Bermudian consulate in Washington D.C. or in the 
nearest city to your normal residential address. When 
obtaining a Bermudian visitor visa, you can be expected 
to reveal the purposes for traveling to Bermuda. 
If you are a national of USA, UK or Canada, you do not 
require any kind of visa to enter Bermuda irrespective of 
whether you are a tourist, business visitor or a work 
permit holder going on a job. You are all set to go once 
you have a valid passport and return tickets (note that 
U.S. passport cards are not acceptable in air travel). 
However nationals of countries other than USA, UK and 
Canada will require a multiple entry transit visa for USA, 
UK or Canada (as applicable depending on one's route). 
This is because such nationals will need to transit and 
return through US, UK or Canada. This visa is known as 
Multi Re-Entry Visa (MRV) which ensures that a visitor is 
able to leave Bermuda, and return to his/her own 
country via US, UK or Canada (as the case may be). 
So nationals who require and have valid MRV (Multi Re-
Entry Visa for US, UK or Canada) can now visit Bermuda 
without requiring any separate visa for Bermuda or visa 
waiver. So tourists, persons on business and work permit 
holders from such countries (including who were earlier 
Visa Controlled Nationals) now do not need a separate 
entry visa for Bermuda. However the following conditions 
must be met by them: 
EFTA_R1_00592695 
EFTA02052765
--- PAGE 31 ---
1) One must show the MRV on arrival in Bermuda which 
must be valid for minimum 45 days beyond the date of 
departure or expiry of work permit (as applicable); 
2) PP# 
be valid for minimum 45 days from 
the date of departure from Bermuda or expiry of work 
permit (as the case may be). Note that this requirement of 
minimum 45 days PP# 
applies only for 
nationals requiring and holding MRV. For others (i.e. 
nationals of US, UK and Canada) one only needs to have 
a passport valid till the return journey is completed; 
3) The traveler must have valid return or onward tickets. 
http://hamilton.usconsulate.gov/how to apply2.html

Who requires the Bermudian holiday visa for take a trip 
from USA? 
Bermudian holiday visa is given for a controlled period of 
leisure travel and no business activities permitted. A 
holiday visa stamp or label placed by a Bermudian visa 
official on your passport that lets you go to Bermuda. 
Travel visa for Bermuda are usually granted by the 
Bermudian consulate in Washington D.C. or in the 
nearest city to your normal residential address. When 
obtaining a Bermudian visitor visa, you can be expected 
to reveal the purposes for traveling to Bermuda. 
If you are a national of USA, UK or Canada, you do not 
require any kind of visa to enter Bermuda irrespective of 
whether you are a tourist, business visitor or a work 
permit holder going on a job. You are all set to go once 
you have a valid passport and return tickets (note that 
EFTA_R1_00592710 
EFTA02052780
--- PAGE 46 ---
U.S. passport cards are not acceptable in air travel). 
However nationals of countries other than USA, UK and 
Canada will require a multiple entry transit visa for USA, 
UK or Canada (as applicable depending on one's route). 
This is because such nationals will need to transit and 
return through US, UK or Canada. This visa is known as 
Multi Re-Entry Visa (MRV) which ensures that a visitor 
is able to leave Bermuda, and return to his/her own 
country via US, UK or Canada (as the case may be). 
So nationals who require and have valid MRV (Multi Re-
Entry Visa for US, UK or Canada) can now visit Bermuda 
without requiring any separate visa for Bermuda or visa 
waiver. So tourists, persons on business and work 
permit holders from such countries (including who were 
earlier Visa Controlled Nationals) now do not need a 
separate entry visa for Bermuda. However the following 
conditions must be met by them: 
1) One must show the MRV on arrival in Bermuda which 
must be valid for minimum 45 days beyond the date of 
departure or expiry of work permit (as applicable); 
2) PP# 
be valid for minimum 45 days from 
the date of departure from Bermuda or expiry of work 
permit (as the case may be). Note that this requirement 
of minimum 45 days PP# 
applies only for 
nationals requiring and holding MRV. For others (i.e. 
nationals of US, UK and Canada) one only needs to have 
a passport valid till the return journey is completed; 
3) The traveler must have valid return or onward tickets.
